simple.meaning: יָגוֹר (yâgôwr) is a Hebrew word meaning “fearful.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יָגוֹר (H3016) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Jeremiah 22:25, with occurrences in Jeremiah.

firstOccurrence.englishText: I would give you into the hand of those who seek your life, and into the hand of them of whom you are afraid, even into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.

timeline.evidenceText: I would give you into the hand of those who seek your life, and into the hand of them of whom you are afraid, even into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.
